responsibility: Defines the user-visible -m target options for the Epiphany port and binds them to backend variables, masks, and enums. It covers register-file restrictions, short-insn preference, branch cost, conditional moves, nop insertion, FP comparison strategy, immediate splitting, post-increment/modify addressing, stack offset, call model, small-address assumptions, FP mode and rounding-related behavior, vector alignment and move splitting, integer use of the FPU, and the dedicated -1 register choice. GCC uses this file to generate option parsing tables and target flag plumbing for the Epiphany backend.
same_name_distinction: This is the option-definition file for the Epiphany port: it declares user-visible -m switches, enums, masks, and backend variables that GCC's option machinery turns into parsing tables, rather than backend implementation code in epiphany.cc, compile-time target macros in epiphany.h, or RTL instruction descriptions in epiphany.md.
